name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 30 - Am 117
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 30 b. Stresses that the best natural barriers against wildfires are, among others, vineyards and pastoral activities; reaffirms that support for agriculture, livestock farming and viticulture is essential to prevent fires of dramatic magnitude and, consequently, to avoid having to further mobilise the Resilience and Values sub-heading, as well as to prevent costly reconstruction spending and human tragedies;
